en.title: Overtime
en.summary: Extra hours for a month, entered before the payroll run picks them up.

sections.heading: Entering it
sections.body:
1. Pick the month at the top.
2. Add the hours against the employee, choosing the overtime type.
3. Save.

The rate belongs to the type, not to the entry — types and their multipliers are set in Admin Panel → Overtime Types. If a figure looks wrong, check the type before you check the hours.

sections.heading: Timing
sections.body: Enter overtime before you run payroll for that month. Anything added afterwards is not in the run: it either waits for the next month or has to go through a payroll adjustment.

sections.heading: Deductions work the same way
sections.body:
All Deductions is the mirror screen — advances, penalties, loans and anything else to be taken off, entered against the month and picked up by that month's run.

Both can also be entered per site, or for one person from their profile.

am.title: ትርፍ ሰዓት
am.summary: የወሩ ተጨማሪ ሰዓቶች፤ ደመወዝ ከመሠራቱ በፊት ይገባሉ።

sections.heading: እንዴት እንደሚገባ
sections.body:
1. ከላይ ወሩን ይምረጡ።
2. ሰዓቶቹን በሠራተኛው ላይ ይጨምሩ፤ የትርፍ ሰዓት ዓይነቱን ይምረጡ።
3. ያስቀምጡ።

መጠኑ የዓይነቱ እንጂ የመዝገቡ አይደለም — ዓይነቶቹና ማባዢያቸው በAdmin Panel → Overtime Types ይቀመጣሉ። አኃዝ ስህተት ከመሰለ ከሰዓቱ በፊት ዓይነቱን ይመልከቱ።

sections.heading: ጊዜው
sections.body: ትርፍ ሰዓትን ለዚያ ወር ደመወዝ ከማስኪያዎ በፊት ያስገቡ። ከዚያ በኋላ የተጨመረ በክፍያው ውስጥ አይካተትም፦ ወይ ቀጣዩን ወር ይጠብቃል ወይም በደመወዝ ማስተካከያ ማለፍ አለበት።

sections.heading: ተቀናሾችም በተመሳሳይ ይሠራሉ
sections.body:
All Deductions ተመሳሳዩ ገጽ ነው — ቅድሚያ ክፍያ፣ ቅጣት፣ ብድርና ሌላ የሚቀነስ ሁሉ በወሩ ተመዝግቦ በዚያ ወር ክፍያ ውስጥ ይካተታል።

ሁለቱም በጣቢያ፣ ወይም ለአንድ ሰው ከመገለጫው ሊገቡ ይችላሉ።
